builds.howItPlays: You trade early with cheap units like Ravenbloom Student and keep runes ready on your opponent's turn for Rebuttal, a reaction that counters a spell costing 4 or less, or takes it over if you pay one more rune. Paying 3 to empower Applied Researchers makes your spells cheaper and empowers Mel too, so she can give an enemy unit -2 Might before a fight, and Thousand-Tailed Watcher, a 7-cost unit that gives every enemy unit -3 Might the turn it enters, closes out the game.
builds.whyYou: You'd rather hold the right answer than play the biggest unit. You like ending your turn with runes still up and making your opponent guess whether you'll counter, shrink or remove what they play next. You don't mind keeping track of when Mel is empowered and saving her for the fight that matters. If you'd rather win with well-timed answers and a few cheap attackers than by racing, Mel is a good fit.
builds.ratingNotes: Re-rated 2026-09-25 from scored decks. The earlier Control 3.5/2.5/6/2.5 came from guide summaries and linked the bare /decks page. It now sits at the mean of three scored decks, and every Axis moved 1.5 or more (Pace +1.5, Stance +1.5, Complexity +1.5, Variance +1.5). The label moves to Tempo, which two of the three raters gave (the third said Control). Each deck's formula suggested Midrange, but the raters read cheap spell-fed units backed by reaction-speed counters and removal. Outside labels were split before (riftboundguide.com Control, skillshotzgaming.com 'Tempo/Control'). Scored decks: Grapplr Mel (dubusmcbernik) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/e50f4f3e-aa9e-4ac9-9155-06f23b13b9a3 Tempo 5.5/4.5/7.5/4; Tidal Control 1.3 (Nono) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/ca132f5e-c806-4801-8cc2-6bdf6330d3f6 Control 4.5/4/7.5/4; Skill Gap Simulator (lucaqualunque, legal post-ban, guide and matchups) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f35947f8-974d-43e0-8cdc-2a6d8f117208 Tempo 4.5/4/7.5/4. Adjustments on every sheet: complexity +1 (the Legend's Disempower -2 Might has to be timed every turn and is recharged by empowering other cards); stance -0.5 (the Legend is a repeatable -2 Might answer at any battlefield). Deciding cards: Pace, from 6-8 cheap units (Ravenbloom Student, Traveling Merchant, Gust Monk) against 4-8 cards costing 5+ (Thousand-Tailed Watcher, Singularity, Time Warp). Stance, from 17 answers (Shock Blast, Star-Crossed, Smoke Screen, Singularity, Rebuttal, Vex, Apathetic) against about 9 pressure cards (a balance of -0.2). Complexity, from 11-12 reactive cards, Applied Researchers' empower and Shock Blast's empowered discount, plus the Legend. Variance, from no luck cards, one swing card (Mel, Defiant Soul) and mostly 2-3 copies. No gap between formula and judgment reached 2. Legend ability: when you empower something else, Mel becomes empowered; disempower and exhaust her to give a unit at a battlefield -2 Might this turn. Also played: Hwei Tideturner Mel, which moves Hwei, Brooding Painter with Tideturner, Ride the Wind and Flash to draw and pump him (Tempo 5/4/8/4, within 1 on every Axis): https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/45666743-e6e1-4fdc-8f32-f2c0c421eeca (Gardial's post-ban list, claimed Top 8 at a 20-player Skirmish), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/8ca15a5c-d78e-40be-80a4-9bf40411ed55, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/2ef4418f-d02a-4667-a35a-22818f42c26f. Also Newly Awakened Empower Mel, zsquar3d's Unlimited Power! (16 likes, 6,180 views), with 3 Mel, Newly Awakened, many empower units and reaction-speed -Might spells (Control 4.5/3.5/8.5/5, one brewer's list): https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/8e2dabf7-d2d6-441d-ac27-e14d23673bfd. Skill Gap Simulator finishes with Time Warp (10 energy, an extra turn); the picks treat it as a finish, not a separate plan. Confidence: medium. Reviewer should check: nearly all the style's strong evidence (Barcelona and Singapore Best of, Rifeli, yatatcg) is from pre-ban lists that ran Stacked Deck, banned 2026-09-18. Gardial's post-ban guide says Mel is no longer very viable. The only legal lists with real evidence are Skill Gap Simulator and a few 1-point lists, so watch the Los Angeles RQ (2026-09-25 to 27). The old guideUrls (riftbound.gg, riftboundguide.com, skillshotzgaming.com) were dropped: they were not re-read for this pass and describe the pre-ban or launch version. guideUrls are now the three scored deck pages, and I took their content from the picks pass rather than fetching them again this run.
